---
title: "Video Pipeline Fixture"
subtitle: "videos.yml -> media_prep.py -> media-fixture-video Release -> shortcodes"
author: "Yunsung Lee"
institute: "WoRV / MaumAI"
title-slide-attributes:
  data-background-gradient: "linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #E8EDF5 100%)"
# Where the shortcodes and `video="@slug"` find the lock file. Real decks under
# Quarto/<genre>/ do not set this: their lock is Figures/<genre>/<deck>/videos.json.
# Three clips, all cut from the repo's own placeholder by
# `python3 scripts/media_prep.py Quarto/_fixtures/video` (see videos.yml); the
# files themselves are gitignored and live on the public Release
# media-fixture-video, which is what every src in the rendered page points at.
# (An HTML comment before the first `##` would become an empty first slide,
# which is why this note sits in the front matter.)
video-manifest: videos.json
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, ../../clean-academic.scss]
    # _fixtures/ is underscore-prefixed, so Quarto treats it as OUTSIDE the
    # project: Quarto/_quarto.yml defaults, the filter, the shortcodes and the
    # font link do NOT apply here and are repeated below. Real decks under
    # Quarto/<genre>/ inherit them from _quarto.yml and set none of this.
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    margin: 0
    center: false
    auto-stretch: false
    slide-number: true
    html-math-method:
      method: katex
      url: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/"
    filters:
      - ../../_filters/slide-types.lua
    shortcodes:
      - ../../_filters/video-card.lua
    include-in-header:
      - text: '<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../fonts/pretendard.css">'
---
